enchantment.enchantment_expansion.ancien: An ancient archery technique from YunLai sect. Greatly increases bow draw speed and arrow flight velocity
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.explos: Arrows explode on impact without breaking terrain; higher levels increase blast radius and damage
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.chain_: Arrows bounce to nearby enemies on hit; higher levels increase bounce count
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.temper: Makes the wearer immune to freezing and heat damage, keeping body temperature stable
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.fall_c: Greatly reduces fall damage and knocks back nearby enemies on hard landings
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.accumu: Hold right-click to charge: 5s per stage (I:1 stage, II:2 stages, III:3 stages). Next attack after full charge deals stage-multiplied damage with small knockback. Switching weapons, taking damage, or 10s without attacking resets the charge
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.ender_: Teleport the shooter to an arrow's impact point. Entity hits teleport to one block in front of the target by default; 3-second cooldown (configurable)
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.illuso: Hitting a creature restores hunger and saturation; higher levels restore more (I: 1/0.5, II: 2/1.0, III: 3/1.5)
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.auto_r: Held or worn items slowly regenerate 1 durability periodically; I: 5s, II: 4s, III: 3s per point. Treasure-only enchantment (loot chests only)
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.deep_s: Boots-only. Hold Shift + scroll mouse wheel underwater to adjust swim speed multiplier (range 1.0~3.0 by default, configurable cap). Scroll up = faster, scroll down = slower; synced between client and server, with bubble particle effects
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.experi: Killing monsters with this weapon drops 50% extra experience (rounded down, min +1). Obtainable via enchanting table, loot chests, fishing, and villager trades
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.durabi: Greatly increases item durability. I: 50% / II: 66% / III: 75% chance to not consume durability (equivalent to 2x/3x/4x linear increase). Mutually exclusive with Unbreaking
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.feathe: Elytra-only. Immune to crash damage while flying. Found only in End Ship / End City loot chests (20% chance). Treasure enchantment
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.sniper: Bow/Crossbow only. Damage +20% per 10 blocks traveled, capped at +100% (50 blocks). Obtainable via enchanting table, villager trades, and fishing
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.wind_r: Faster on land, walk on water
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.creati: Breaking blocks has a chance to drop rare treasures
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.yunlai: While held: Attack Speed +2.5, Attack Reach +2.5 blocks, Damage x1.10; melee hits have 60% chance to launch a light-blue sword-qi crescent (Damage x0.5, 6-block range) that pierces enemies in a line
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.ancien: While held: Attack Speed +5.0, Attack Reach +5.0 blocks, Damage x1.50; melee hits have 75% chance to launch a golden sword-qi crescent (Damage x0.75, 10-block range) that pierces enemies in a line
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.elegan: Swift as a cat, light as a cat
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.snatch: Chance to steal enemy equipment, higher level = higher chance
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.plunde: Guaranteed rare loot & monster gear drops; higher level = more & fresher
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.dawn.d: Permanent growth per kill: +DMG, +Crit Rate, +Crit DMG, +2.5 Range. Execute: guaranteed crit (x2 dmg) when target <=15% HP. Kill lifesteal: heal 5% of target max HP. Kill splash: 50% of target max HP magic damage in 3 blocks. Pierce the Night: 3-kill combo or HP <=40% activates for 8s (Combo Burst: dmg x1.5, +10% speed, +2 reach; Low-HP Rage: dmg x1.4, 5% lifesteal), shared 15s cooldown. Boss kills grant extra growth
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.qianpo: Deals bonus damage on attack, higher level deals more damage
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.glacia: Infuses arrows with ice crystal power. Longer charge = greater power. AoE damage and enemy pull on hit
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.auto_s: Ores drop smelted products directly. Higher level gives chance for extra drops
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.artisa: Tools remember mined blocks, becoming faster with chance for extra drops
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.levis_: Attacks stack marks. At 3 stacks, detonate magic damage based on max health (target health >= 50)
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.bloodt: Hitting mobs heals 10% max HP (5s cooldown)
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.flywhe: Press R to dash toward crosshair. Invincible during dash, pass through entities. Stop at walls with durability refund
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.ex_nih: Mining stone blocks may drop ores; shearing leaves preserves golden apple drops
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.chain_: While holding ~, mining a block also breaks surrounding blocks of the same type (I:3x3x3, II:5x5x5, III:9x9x9). Each extra block costs 0.5 durability, max 10 per swing (low-durability protection)
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.diffic: Higher difficulty grants stronger bonuses: Peaceful(none), Easy(dmg+1/spd+0.2/armor+1/tough+0.5), Normal(dmg+2/spd+0.4/armor+2/tough+1.0), Hard(dmg+4/spd+0.6/armor+3/tough+1.5)
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.lightn: Summons lightning when hitting an entity with a trident: Tier I requires rain (thunder not needed); Tier II works in all weather and dimensions including Nether and End
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.end_ap: Weapon damage increased by 250%, attack cooldown reduced by 90%
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.entrop: Entropy mark stacks on hit. 2 stacks: slow. Full stacks: detonate 30% lost HP as true damage, spreads
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.smokel: Scroll wheel adjusts elytra speed, no fireworks needed
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.swift_: Crossbow bolts deal bonus magic damage (ignores armor) and load faster. I:+2/+0.25s, II:+4/+0.5s, III:+6/+1.0s, IV:+8/+1.25s
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.spring: Right-click to till a 3x3 (I) or 5x5 (II) area, or harvest all mature crops with auto-replant
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.all_na: Right-click on immature crops to bone-meal the 3x3 (I) / 5x5 (II) area
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.fertil: While held, crops within 10 blocks grow faster; doubles Spring Harvest yields
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.dark_w: Fully concealed: never triggers sculk sensors/shriekers, produces no vibrations, and even a face-to-face Warden cannot detect you (active everywhere; can be biome-limited via config)
enchantment.enchantment_expansion.eterna: Attacks apply Spark mark (2% max HP/sec true dmg, stacks boost dmg, spreads on death)
advancements.enchantment_expansion.the_e: The End is not the end. (Obtain the End Star to start a new game experience)
item.enchantment_expansion.sword_of_the_: Though we return to dust, our will endures on this blade.
message.enchantment_expansion.sotfw.acti: §6§l【Will of Man】Activated! +150% damage for 10 min, 90% chance to strike lightning!
message.enchantment_expansion.sotfw.cool: §a§l【Will of Man】Cooldown complete! Ready to use!
advancements.enchantment_expansion.we_fa: Though we return to dust, our will endures on this blade.
§5Obtain the sword of the free will
item.enchantment_expansion.ocean_star.de: The abyss bows before you. No need to breathe underwater; immune to drowning.
book.enchantment_expansion.enchantment_e: Welcome to the Book of the End. This tome catalogs the enchantments and special items of this mod. All enchantment values are adjustable in the config files.
enchantment_expansion.terminal_book.ench: This category lists the mod's added enchantments, including their applicable items, effects, levels, acquisition methods, and conflicts.
enchantment_expansion.terminal_book.weap: This category introduces the mod's weapons and weapon-focused combat content, including special weapons, melee effects, and combat mechanics.
enchantment_expansion.terminal_book.expa: This category lists the mod's added enchantments, including their applicable items, effects, levels, acquisition methods, and conflicts.
enchantment_expansion.terminal_book.item: This category lists special items from Enchantment Expansion, their acquisition methods, and their passive or active effects.
